title: Raspberry Pi
scope: Raspberry Pi deployment, target-optimized local inference/hardware/audio adapters and headless/UI modes using shared contracts.
next_action: Keep ready; claim a bounded Raspberry Pi foundation item only after shared runtime/platform contracts needed by it are stable.
historical_backlog: Raspberry Pi is a distinct target, not generic Linux.
Future node scope includes headless/UI operation, local inference sized to hardware, audio/voice and Diagnostics parity.
Preserve planned GPIO/UART/CAN/I2C/SPI integration for home/vehicle/embedded use.
Do not start broad Pi porting before shared runtime contracts are stable enough to avoid another fork.
